name: Card_Not_Received
definition: Customer is inquiring about the status, delay, or tracking of a new or replacement card that has not yet arrived.

name: Card_Lost_Stolen
definition: Customer reports that their card has been lost or stolen and needs assistance blocking or replacing it.

name: Card_Activation
definition: Customer needs help activating a new card or retrieving a passcode/PIN for activation.

name: Card_Acceptance
definition: Customer asks where their card is accepted or which ATMs support their card.

name: Card_Retrieval
definition: Customer has physically lost their card inside an ATM or card machine.

name: Card_Expiry
definition: Customer has a query regarding an expiring or expired card.

name: Card_Disposable_Limits
definition: Customer asks about limits regarding the creation or usage of disposable or virtual cards.

name: Contactless_Payments
definition: Customer has questions about using contactless features or troubleshooting contactless payment failures.

name: Top_Up_General
definition: General inquiries about topping up the account, including limits, methods, and international cards.

name: Top_Up_Status
definition: Issues regarding the status of a top-up, including reverted, pending, or failed transactions.

name: Auto_Top_Up
definition: Customer requests assistance with setting up or managing automatic top-ups.

name: ATM_Withdrawal_Issue
definition: Customer reports an error with an ATM withdrawal, such as not receiving cash or the machine malfunctioning.

name: ATM_Limits_Locations
definition: Customer asks about ATM withdrawal limits, fees, or finding specific ATM locations.

name: ATM_PIN_Services
definition: Customer inquires about changing or retrieving their PIN at an ATM.

name: Transfer_Issues
definition: Customer reports that a money transfer to another person has failed, is pending, or is missing from the balance.

name: Incoming_Transfers
definition: Customer asks how to receive money from others.

name: Fraud_Unrecognized_Transaction
definition: Customer suspects fraudulent activity, unauthorized use of their card, or sees transactions they do not recognize.

name: Identity_Verification
definition: Customer asks about the requirements or process to verify their identity for the account.

name: Currency_Exchange
definition: Customer asks about exchanging currencies (e.g., GBP to USD) or available currency options.

name: Account_Closure
definition: Customer requests to delete or terminate their account.

name: Payment_Declined
definition: Customer reports that a card payment was declined by the merchant or bank.

name: Payment_Pending
definition: Customer inquires why a card payment is stuck in a pending state.

name: Refund_Request
definition: Customer asks how to process a refund for a purchase made with the card.

name: Card_Link
definition: Customer asks how to link their card to the account or app.

name: Crypto_Compliance
definition: Queries regarding the ability to buy cryptocurrency or policy restrictions on crypto transactions.

name: App_Login_Issues
definition: Queries regarding difficulties logging into the mobile app or online banking system.

name: Virtual_Card_Request
definition: Queries regarding the creation, retrieval, or usage of disposable or virtual cards.

name: Card_Unblock
definition: Queries regarding unblocking a card that has been blocked or frozen, or reversing a freeze status.

name: Card_Freeze
definition: Queries requesting to temporarily freeze or block a card or account due to security concerns or loss.

name: Card_Damaged
definition: Queries reporting a physically damaged, broken, or unusable card.

name: Card_Replacement
definition: Queries regarding the process for replacing a card that is damaged, lost, or expiring.

name: Card_Type_Info
definition: Queries asking about the types of cards available (e.g., Visa vs Mastercard) or card network details.

name: Passcode_Reset
definition: Queries regarding resetting or recovering the app passcode or login PIN.

name: Top_Up_Methods
definition: Queries regarding the specific methods (e.g., American Express, external banks) available to top up an account.

name: Balance_Update_Issue
definition: Queries reporting that an account balance has not updated correctly after a transaction.

name: Exchange_Rates
definition: Queries asking about current exchange rates, how they are calculated, or specific rate details.

name: Fees_General
definition: Queries asking why a specific fee was charged or explaining general fee structures.

name: Transfer_Fees
definition: Queries specifically regarding fees applied to money transfers.

name: Purchase_Cancel
definition: Queries regarding cancelling a purchase or stopping a payment after it has been made.

name: Card_Status_Check
definition: Queries asking to verify if a card is active, working, or valid for use.

name: Direct_Debit_Dispute
definition: Queries reporting unauthorized or unrecognized direct debit payments.

name: Top_Up_Limits
definition: Queries regarding the maximum limits for topping up an account.

name: Transfer_Methods
definition: Queries asking how to transfer money into an account or initiate a transfer.

name: ATM_Cash_Discrepancy
definition: Queries reporting that the cash received from an ATM differs from the amount requested.

name: Location_Services
definition: Queries asking about the bank's physical locations, branches, or supported regions.

name: Source_of_Funds_Verification
definition: Queries regarding the requirement to validate or prove the source of funds.

name: Update_Personal_Details
definition: Customer needs to update personal information such as address, name, or contact details.

name: Transfer_Rules_Beneficiary
definition: Inquiries regarding the rules, limits, or requirements for transferring money to a beneficiary.

name: Transaction_Reversal
definition: Customer requests to reverse or undo a specific transaction that has already been processed.

name: PIN_Unblock
definition: Customer needs to unblock a PIN that has been locked due to incorrect attempts.

name: Transfer_Timeframe
definition: Questions regarding how long a transfer takes to process or arrive at the destination.

name: Duplicate_Transaction
definition: Customer reports being charged twice for the same transaction or seeing duplicate charges.

name: Card_Delivery
definition: Questions regarding the shipping status, delivery timeframes, or delivery location of a card.

name: Salary_Deposit
definition: Customer inquires about how to receive salary payments into their account.

name: Card_Order
definition: Customer wants to order or request a new physical card.

name: ATM_Card_Retention
definition: Customer reports that an ATM has retained or swallowed their card.

name: Direct_Debit_Unrecognized
definition: Customer disputes or does not recognize a direct debit transaction on their account.

name: Card_Cancellation
definition: Customer requests to cancel their card permanently.

name: Card_Spare_Request
definition: Customer wants to order additional or spare cards for their account.

name: Top_Up_Verification
definition: Questions regarding the verification process required for topping up an account.

name: Top_Up_Supported_Currencies
definition: Inquiries about which currencies are supported for adding money to the account.

name: Top_Up_Digital_Wallet
definition: Customer wants to top up their account using a digital wallet service like Google Pay or Apple Pay.

name: ATM_Withdrawal_Fee
definition: Questions or disputes regarding fees charged specifically for ATM cash withdrawals.

name: Exchange_Fee_Inquiry
definition: Questions regarding the fees applied to currency exchange transactions.

name: Account_Access_Device_Lost
definition: Customer has lost their phone or device and needs help accessing their account.

name: Identity_Verification_Alternative
definition: Customer asks if they can use the account without verifying identity or needs an alternative verification method.

name: Incoming_Transfer_Methods
definition: Customer asks how someone else can send money to their account.

name: Virtual_Card_Issues
definition: Queries regarding non-physical cards not working, usage issues, or generation limits.

name: Card_Delivery_Eligibility
definition: Questions regarding eligibility for card delivery based on location or region (e.g., outside UK).

name: Password_Reset
definition: Issues related to resetting passwords or login credentials not being accepted.

name: Cheque_Deposit
definition: Inquiries about adding money to the account via cheque.

name: Transfer_Eligibility
definition: Questions regarding requirements or eligibility to make transfers (e.g., currency requirements).

name: Verification_Code_Info
definition: Requests for information about verification codes (e.g., SMS codes, OTPs).

name: Age_Eligibility
definition: Inquiries regarding the minimum age requirement to hold an account.

name: Card_Reactivation
definition: Requests to add a previously lost, blocked, or old card back into the system.

name: Region_Support
definition: Inquiries about supported regions or countries for banking services (e.g., EU support).

name: Physical_Card_Request
definition: Requests specifically for a physical card.
